source_run_manifest.timing_scope: Per-process CPU seconds reported separately for producer, checker and oracle; not deployment latency.
source_run_manifest.simulation_scope: Pseudorandom independent-replicate simulation under stipulated mathematical laws; no empirical assumption estimation.

inference_scope: Each cell has 200 independent-replicate simulation units; cells share matched streams. Do not pool the 2400 rows as independent trials.
secondary_interval_scope: Pointwise 95% Clopper-Pearson; not simultaneous across rates.

paired_ablations.difference_scope: Numerical paired differences use both-completed pairs; no unavailable pair is silently replaced.
